# Run book: Compare a set of vectors

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/compare-vectors.md) | [Spec](../specs/compare-vectors.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)
- [Preconditions](#preconditions)

- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

One vector type and four metrics give a quick check of whether embeddings group the way you expect before they go into a store.

## Preconditions

- The example stack is running.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Compare a set of vectors"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/utilities/vector-lab`:

1. **Compare the sample vectors.** Four three-value vectors are filled in. Compare them with the cosine metric. Expect: A 4 by 4 distance matrix appears with zeros on the diagonal. The lengths and centroid are shown.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Compare is disabled | A line is not numeric or the lines have different lengths | Give one vector per line with the same number of values |
| Cosine distance is NaN | A vector of all zeros has no direction | Remove zero vectors or use the Euclidean metric |

Related framework features: OoBDev.System.Abstractions (`Vector`, `VectorMath`, `VectorDistanceMetrics`).
